parent.seed_none: Shallow-copy SamplingParams once,setn1,cache same childparam reference for reuse.
parent.seeded: Separate copy with seed+child index;do not replace by one common seed or reorder logicalchild indices.
parent.streaming: Finished child is removed;already-finished-and-returned child suppressed. Other output is returned with finished=(no remainingchildren).
parent.final_only: Store by completion.index;publish aggregation only after children set empty.
parent.C8_scope: n1 direct path,so parent body is an analyzed alternative;all downstream request mutation/transport paths not globally excluded.

sentinel.empty_buffer: Collector stores singleton;generate observes finishedTrue and identity check suppresses yielding it.
sentinel.pending_payload: Collector.add merges singleton into pending payload,sets finishedTrue,keeps payload object;generate yields that payload because identity differs.
sentinel.clone_witness: Cloning empty sentinel loses identity and can yield an extra empty RequestOutput.
sentinel.discard_witness: Treating any terminal insertion as discard would drop an existing pending payload.
sentinel.scope: Source state-machine witnesses,not a runtime interleaving/native/transport test. Preserve exception precedence and resumable cleanup.

actual_resumable_exclusion_scope: Source-selected normal completion text input;all later processor/request mutation not historically snapshotted.
